Plexor runs its control plane in a single binary (`Plexor.Host`) with PostgreSQL as state DB, NATS as event bus, and a node-agent on every compute node. Compute, Network, Storage, Identity, Tenants, Billing, Telemetry, Marketplace are modules inside one binary (modular monolith, extraction-ready by measured bottleneck).

## What the platform does

<Cards>
  <Card icon={<AccountTree className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Tenants & Projects" description="Organization → Project hierarchy with per-tenant and per-project quotas. Every resource lives in one of these scope zones." />
  <Card icon={<DeployedCode className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Compute" description="Virtual machines (KVM default, LXD/Firecracker as alternatives), flavors, images, lifecycle, snapshots, noVNC console." />
  <Card icon={<Globe className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Network" description="VPC, subnets, security groups, floating IP, load balancer, DNS zones. OVS/Cilium for overlay networking." />
  <Card icon={<HardDisk className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Storage" description="Block volumes (Ceph RBD / local-lvm), S3-compatible buckets (Ceph RGW / MinIO), VM and volume snapshots." />
  <Card icon={<Key className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Identity" description="OIDC via Keycloak, RBAC with permissions like compute.vms.create, SSH keys, API keys for service accounts." />
  <Card icon={<ShoppingBag className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Marketplace" description="App providers catalog (WordPress, PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak, Ghost, custom). One-command install, authoring via YAML provider spec." />
  <Card icon={<Layers className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="Metering & Billing" description="NATS events from every state transition, rollups into metering_hourly, monthly invoice generation." />
  <Card icon={<Terminal className="size-4" aria-hidden />} title="API & CLI" description="OpenAPI source-generator emits artifacts/openapi.json on every build. Kubb generates a TS client for the web. CLI `plx` is a NativeAOT binary." />
</Cards>

## App providers vs install providers

Plexor distinguishes **install providers** (KVM, Ceph, OVS — infrastructure choice at `plx init`) from **app providers** (WordPress, PostgreSQL — user-app deployment templates via marketplace). App providers are YAML with shell commands, not NuGet plugins: see [Marketplace](/en/marketplace).

## Security

Multi-tenant by default: everything flows through `tenant_id` in JWT claims, global EF Core query filters. Audit log on every mutating action, append-only with 7-year retention. Secrets live only in env / vault, never in config files.
